Responden Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of Ind praying to issue a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus to call for the recor pertaining to the impugned notification in Notification No.02/MRB/2021 d 16.02.2023 and the consequential impugned Provisional Selection List in 02/Mrb/2021 dated 13.03.2023 on the file of the respondent no.2 and quas the same as illegal and consequently for a direction, directing the resp no.2 to provide 2 additional marks for the Question nos.16 and 62 (Batch considering the representation of the petitioner dated 27.03.2023 and to the Selection List for the post of Food Safety Officer by following the down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Rajesh Kumar Daria v. Rajasthan Public Service Commission reported in (2007) 8 Scc 685 within the time period stipulated by this Court.
texts.facts: Medical Recruitment Services Board issued notification dated 13.10.2021 calling for applications from eligible candidates for the post of Food Safety Officer. Totally, 131 vacancies were notified. The petitioner was one of the applicants. The petitioner belongs to Scheduled Caste community. In the provisional list, the petitioner's name was not included. Hence, this present writ petition has been filed challenging her non-selection. The second respondent has filed counter affidavit. He called upon this Court to dismiss this writ petition.
